candidate.prompt:
Empty stylized 3D animated feature-film background plate, warm family kitchen at soft morning, 16:9 widescreen. Camera: eye-level wide master shot from the dining side of the room, slight three-quarter view, capturing the full kitchen wall and generous open central floor space kept completely clear for later character staging.

Room geography: along the back wall, left to right — a tall cream refrigerator with a small child's scribbled crayon drawing (lopsided sun, floating blue sky strip, color outside the lines) held by two magnets; then a farmhouse sink under a wide window with simple gingham half-curtains, dishes neatly stacked on a drying rack beside it; then a four-burner stove with a kettle and a range hood above; then butcher-block counter running to the right corner with a fruit bowl of apples. Upper wooden cabinets flank the window, a few mugs on open hooks. A pencil-drawn growth-chart mark column penciled faintly on the doorframe trim at far right, no readable text.

Foreground/middle: large unobstructed warm-toned wood floor area in the center of frame, a round braided rug pushed near the sink, a small wooden kitchen table with two chairs tucked at the far left edge of frame, mostly out of shot. Background details: potted herbs on the windowsill, folded tea towel over the oven handle, soft shadows grounded and consistent.

Palette and lighting: warm honey, cream and sage-green palette with one subdued terracotta accent only (the kettle); soft golden morning sunlight streaming in from the window at left, gentle volumetric light, soft ambient bounce, cozy quiet atmosphere.

Style: high-end feature-animation production CG, hand-crafted stylized shapes, believable materials, cohesive perspective and proportions, clean composition with clear sightlines. Strictly no people, no animals, no human figures or faces anywhere including artwork or reflections, no readable text, labels, captions, logos or watermarks. An invented generic family home, not a real location.

reviews.findings: Inspected the actual candidate.webp bytes against the packet criteria. The image is an aspect-correct 16:9, warm, stylized 3D family kitchen interior. The center foreground holds clear, unobstructed wooden floor space (with only a low braided rug) suitable for character staging. Lighting is soft, warm morning light entering through the window. No people, animals, or human figures appear anywhere. The only artwork is a child's crayon drawing magnetized to the fridge (sun, blue and green scribbles) containing no faces. A height/growth chart with measure marks on the right wall is functional wall decoration, not a caption, logo, or watermark. No captions, logos, or watermarks observed in any region. All stated criteria are satisfied with no observable defects. REVIEWER-INDEPENDENT-512

Direct inspection of the full frame shows a warm, stylized 3D kitchen with believable geography (fridge left, sink under window center-left, stove/range-hood right, readable counters, soft morning window light, wood floor with rug). However, the criteria explicitly require an EMPTY background with no people or human figures and clear central floor space for later character staging. A fully rendered adult male human figure (curly hair, beard, cream sweater, brown pants, shoes) stands in the exact center of the frame, occupying the central floor staging area. This is an objective, disqualifying violation regardless of filename or producer claims. The fridge drawing (sun and scribbles) contains no faces, and no captions, logos, or watermarks are visible; those criteria pass. Reviewer marker: REVIEWER-INDEPENDENT-512.
